title: lichend treats identity/epoch storage errors and malformed records as first boot
description: P1 security review. Startup uses load_seed(&storage).ok().flatten() and load_epoch(&storage).ok().flatten().unwrap_or(128). Any read/I/O error is discarded; malformed-length records also map to None. Seed failure generates and writes a new identity before later mismatch exit, while epoch failure resets/persists 128. This contradicts fail-closed comments, destroys recovery evidence, and permits replay-state rollback. Distinguish Missing from Corrupt/Unavailable, create state only on confirmed missing first boot, never overwrite failed existing records, and test I/O errors, short/long records, corruption, and rollback.
